original_title: Beaumont Library District prepares for 100th anniversary

caption: Modern exterior view of the Beaumont Library District's Carnegie library building, published with an August 27, 2010 Press-Enterprise article about preparations for the district's centennial.
description: A modern exterior view of the same Carnegie library facade shown in the undated Calisphere photograph, but a distinct photograph. The accompanying article describes the district's 1911 approval, its first rooms in a local bank, the Carnegie grant and the 1914 opening of the Eighth Street building.
